verdict.rationale: Source for a peripheral component, the New Relic CLI, is public on GitHub, and one community comment mentions open-source agents in passing. Nothing in the pack shows that the core observability platform's source is readable or under an open license. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for any component, evidence that the agents' source is published, any open source for the core platform/backend, and first-party documentation of the licensing.
